# Greenlight

> Self-hosted HTTP gateway that gives AI agents a human-in-the-loop line to Telegram, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Discord, Google Chat, WhatsApp, and Messenger — interactive prompts, per-channel credentials, and signed callbacks.

Greenlight is source-available under BUSL-1.1 (not OSI open source until the Change Date).

## Docs

- [Introduction](/): Product overview and choose-your-path
- [Quickstart](/getting-started/quickstart): Self-hosting and development quickstarts

- [Concepts](/getting-started/concepts): PROMPT vs MESSAGE, auth layers, platform adapters
- [Admin UI](/getting-started/admin-ui): Setup, channels, prompts, settings
- [Docker](/self-hosting/docker): Self-host Compose and Swarm

- [API-only](/self-hosting/api-only): Run without the Admin UI
